original_reference_provenance.finding: Historical Julia genuinely calls cuBLAS batched GELS for all4 native data types and fixtures. Named adapter aligns raw vendor ABI, pinned system library and preallocated pointer arrays with native; historical high-level wrapper allocated pointer arrays and info buffers within its timed call. This is a P1 host/library boundary adaptation, not a changed solver. Full complex modulus replaces the original cancellation-prone sqrt(abs(real(residual*residual))) check.

measurement_phase.reason: Raw cuBLAS handle defaults to legacy stream0; no-argument CUDA.synchronize waits task-local stream, not necessarily vendor work. Correct every boundary to context-wide CUDA.synchronize(CUDA.context()), matching cudaDeviceSynchronize.

timing_completion: Explicit CUDA.synchronize(CUDA.context()) before/after raw vendor calls, matching native cudaDeviceSynchronize.
